[[File:SW_Executor_01.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], flagship of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]]]
A '''flagship''' was the primary [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] in a commander's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and the one that the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was aboard.

==Description==
[[File:WildKarrde-SWG4.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''[[Wild Karrde]]'', Talon Kardde's flagship]]
For the safety of the ranking [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and possibly for intimidation, the flagship was usually the most powerful ship available in the fleet, such as a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]]. However, it is interesting to note that this was not always the case, as [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was known to have ships larger than an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] in his fleet, yet made the Star Destroyer [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] his flagship. Similarly, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] has never been recorded in commanding the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' despite his position as commander of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] for many years, and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] commanded his old Dreadnaught [[Peregrine (Dreadnaught-class)|''Peregrine'']] for years after joining the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], despite its smaller size and firepower.

The flagship, such as [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], was considered the command ship of the entire [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Significantly, a flagship could easily be changed in the middle of a deployment or even a battle, as the primary definition of a flagship was the ship that had the highest ranking command officer onboard, making it the command ship for the fleet. However, [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other smaller ships such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], even when carrying the highest ranked member of the fleet, were not usually considered flagships.

While throughout galactic history, flagships have traditionally been powerful battleships capable of slagging any other ship in combat, the New Republic and the [[Ssi-ruu]]k developed different strategies in the use of starfighter carriers as flagships, such as the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]] in the [[New Class Modernization Program|New Class]]. This was due to the more prevalent roles that starfighters played in the New Republic and Ssi-ruu navies respectively.
